source_inspections.origin_group: U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Mississippi
source_inspections.evidence_extract: The October 19 opinion allowed the United States, acting for EPA, to intervene but held that neither Rule 41 nor the Clean Air Act permits it to unilaterally dismiss the NAACP citizen suit over the plaintiffs’ objection. The United States may file a Rule 24(c) pleading by October 23; the defendants’ dismissal motion and other merits-related motions remain unresolved.
